\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\vspace{4pt}\scriptsize \textit{Notes:} Approximate replication of Mollick and Cabral (2011), five-year blocks: log GDP per capita at the end of the block on its lag, population growth, log investment and log government consumption / GDP measured in the last year of the previous block (t\_p $-$ 1) or as the block mean. Fixed effects: country fixed effects, standard errors clustered by country, wild cluster bootstrap CI and p (Webb weights, 9,999 replications). System GMM: two-step, Windmeijer-corrected standard errors, normal CI. Difference: the two measures stacked with measure-specific controls and country $\times$ measure fixed effects, wild cluster bootstrap. Panel B differs from these rows in the GMM step and in inference: its System GMM is one-step with robust standard errors (hence the small differences in the coefficients, e.g. $-$0.072 one-step against $-$0.068 two-step for the period mean in 1986--2023) and its fixed-effects CIs and stars come from standard errors clustered by country (e.g. t\_p $-$ 1 in 1986--2004: $-$0.078, clustered CI [$-$0.133; $-$0.024], wild bootstrap p = 0.081). Exploratory (post-plan, pre-registered in the fourth addendum).\end{minipage}
